name: login-form
title: Login form
description: Account/password login card built on shadcn ui primitives; submits through the auth util and hands the post-sign-in navigation back to the host.
postInstall: Render <LoginForm labels={...} onLoggedIn={...} /> inside your auth shell. The host supplies translated labels, the app path to open after sign-in (redirectPath, usually read from ?redirect=) and the onLoggedIn callback that performs the navigation. Requires the shadcn ui primitives button, card, input and label, plus the auth item for the login helper.
